title: Finance Core Complete
prompt: Given the Txn model in scope, implement all four: `int total_by_cat(const Txn *txs, int n, int cat)` (sum of cents in category cat), `int biggest_idx(const Txn *txs, int n)` (index of largest cents, ties lowest index, -1 for n==0), `int after_balance(const Txn *txs, int n, int start)` (start + all cents), and `void fmt_report(const Txn *txs, int n, int start, char *out)` writing `txns=<n> balance=<b>` where b is after_balance (snprintf).

tests.name: report
